tags.name: External Partners
tags.description: Mobile Payments API for external partners integration. Requires API Key authentication via X-MP-ApiKey header.

post.description: Calculates the total amount of a shopping cart including VAT. This endpoint computes the individual item totals, discounts, and VAT amounts based on the configured VAT percentages. Use this before creating a payment to validate cart totals.

400.description: Invalid parameters or VAT calculation error

post.description: Cancels a previously created captive (pre-authorization) payment. This releases the hold on the customer's account. The payment must be identified by either paymentId or externalReference.

400.description: Invalid parameters or payment cannot be cancelled

post.description: Confirms a previously created captive (pre-authorization) payment with the final amount. The final amount can be less than or equal to the maximum amount specified during creation. This completes the payment and transfers the final amount from the customer's account.

400.description: Invalid parameters or final amount exceeds maximum

post.description: Creates a captive payment request that pre-authorizes an estimated amount on the customer's account. The final amount can be different from the estimated amount but cannot exceed the maximum amount. This is useful for scenarios like fuel stations or hotels where the final amount is unknown at the time of authorization. The captive payment must be confirmed or cancelled within the validity period.

Creates a new mobile payment request with a fixed amount. The customer will receive a push notification to approve the payment. Upon successful creation, a paymentId and expirationDate are returned. The payment must be confirmed by the customer before the expiration date.
Generates a QR code image for a payment at a specific acceptance point. The QR code can be scanned by customers to initiate a payment. The response contains the image as a Base64-encoded string.

get.description: Retrieves the list of available VAT percentages that can be applied to shopping cart items. Each VAT percentage has an ID, description, and value. Use these IDs when building a shopping cart to specify the VAT rate for each item.
Retrieves information about a specific acceptance point (store location) for a merchant. Returns the friendly name of the acceptance point which can be displayed to customers.

404.description: Merchant or acceptance point not found

get.description: Retrieves the current status of a mobile payment request. The payment can be queried by either paymentId or externalReference. The response includes a cryptographic signature (HMAC-SHA256) to ensure message authenticity and integrity.

parameters.name: externalReference
parameters.description: External reference provided when creating the payment

parameters.name: paymentId
parameters.description: Payment ID returned when creating the payment

post.description: Initiates a mobile payment request where the customer confirms via OTP in a WebView. The customer receives an OTP that must be entered in the confirmation URL to approve the payment. This flow is suitable for web-based checkout integrations.

get.description: Validates whether the provided MSISDN (phone number) is associated with a valid customer who can receive mobile payment requests. This should be called before creating a payment to ensure the customer exists and is eligible for payments.
